newsitem.title: USA: Interactive sees Q4/YR shr below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Interactive sees Q4/YR shr below estimates.

text.p: Interactive Group Inc said Friday it expects to report record revenues but sees its earnings falling below analysts' expectations for the quarter and year ended December 31, 1996.
The company said it expects net income of $0.11 to $0.14 per share for the fourth quarter, versus a loss of $0.31 per share for the 1995 quarter.
For the year, the company said it expects to report per share net income of $0.24 to $0.27, compared with a loss of $0.28 in 1995.
Wall Street was expecting fourth quarter profits of $0.21 per share and full-year profits of $0.36 per share, according to First Call.
The company said its fourth quarter revenues should be about $15.8 million, compared with $10.3 million for the 1995 period.
Interactive Group said it would report its results the week of February 17.
